title: Microsoft Edge: v.149 - Modern, unified, and updated Look and Feel
description: Microsoft Edge will update the Look and Feel to give customers a unified experience across all of Microsoft AI surfaces including Copilot and Bing. This will change multiple elements of the UX such as spacing, corners, fonts, default colors, etc.
